info.description: The codefly-base solution's backend under the authority interface, at the route the authority's edge forwards it on: the routes it serves itself, and the module calls the solution runtime relays as the viewer. A relayed call is any checked caller's, because the child the authority issues through this solution's binding for that module, and the module's own method policy, gate it.
info.title: codefly-base solution backend

get.description:
This solution's own page, to show that it is installed and reachable as the viewer

Answers the solution's id and the `as` name of every module this backend relays, in the order they are declared. Takes no parameters and reads nothing outside this backend
